request.project_task: Create a marketplace buyer-seller dispute workflow.
request.project_goal: Resolve order disputes with traceable evidence and deadlines.
request.project_description: A buyer opens a dispute, both parties provide evidence, and a mediator decides or proposes a settlement.

functional_requirements.text: A buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order.

atoms.text: A buyer opens a dispute for an eligible order.

functional_requirements.text: The buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.

atoms.text: The buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.

functional_requirements.text: The buyer and seller upload evidence before a deadline.

atoms.text: The buyer and seller upload evidence before a deadline.

functional_requirements.text: The system notifies each party about new evidence.

atoms.text: The system notifies each party about new evidence.

functional_requirements.text: A mediator reviews order history and evidence.

atoms.text: A mediator reviews order history and evidence.

functional_requirements.text: A mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.

atoms.text: A mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.

functional_requirements.text: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.

atoms.text: Either party accepts a proposed settlement.

functional_requirements.text: The system closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.

atoms.text: The system closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.

non_functional_requirements.text: Evidence must be immutable after the submission deadline.
A mediator must not access disputes with a declared conflict of interest.

actors.name: Buyer
actors.description: The party who purchased the order and may open a dispute.

actors.name: Seller
actors.description: The party who sold the order and may upload evidence.

actors.name: Mediator
actors.description: The neutral party who reviews evidence and decides or proposes a settlement.

use_cases.name: Open Dispute
use_cases.goal: Allow a buyer to open a dispute for an eligible order by selecting a reason and requested outcome.
use_cases.trigger: Buyer initiates a dispute for an eligible order.

preconditions.text: The buyer has an eligible order.

success_postconditions.text: A dispute is created with the selected reason and requested outcome.

steps.action: Buyer selects an eligible order and initiates a dispute.
Buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.
System creates the dispute and records the reason and requested outcome.

user_stories.capability: open a dispute for an eligible order
user_stories.benefit: I can seek resolution for a problematic order.

system_stories.responsibility: Persist the dispute with reason and requested outcome.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Open Dispute
Goal: Allow a buyer to open a dispute for an eligible order by selecting a reason and requested outcome.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Buyer initiates a dispute for an eligible order.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The buyer has an eligible order.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Buyer selects an eligible order and initiates a dispute.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Buyer selects a reason and requested outcome.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System creates the dispute and records the reason and requested outcome.
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Submit Evidence
use_cases.goal: Allow buyer and seller to upload evidence before the deadline and notify each party about new evidence.
use_cases.trigger: A party uploads evidence for an open dispute.

preconditions.text: The evidence submission deadline has not passed.

success_postconditions.text: Evidence is uploaded and both parties are notified.

steps.action: Buyer or seller uploads evidence before the deadline.
System notifies each party about the new evidence.
Buyer or seller attempts to upload evidence after the deadline.
steps.expected_result: System rejects the upload because evidence is immutable after the deadline.

user_stories.benefit: I can support my dispute claim.
I can defend against the dispute claim.

system_stories.responsibility: Persist evidence and prevent modification after the deadline.
Send notifications to buyer and seller when evidence is uploaded.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Submit Evidence
Goal: Allow buyer and seller to upload evidence before the deadline and notify each party about new evidence.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: A party uploads evidence for an open dispute.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: A dispute is open.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The evidence submission deadline has not passed.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Buyer or seller uploads evidence before the deadline.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System notifies each party about the new evidence.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Evidence submitted after deadline
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Mediate Dispute
use_cases.goal: Allow a mediator to review order history and evidence, then propose a settlement or record a decision.
use_cases.trigger: Mediator begins review of an open dispute.

preconditions.text: A dispute is open and evidence submission is complete or deadline has passed.
The mediator has no declared conflict of interest with the dispute.

success_postconditions.text: A settlement is proposed or a decision is recorded.

failure_postconditions.text: No settlement or decision is recorded.

steps.action: Mediator reviews order history and evidence.
Mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.
Mediator attempts to access a dispute with a declared conflict of interest.

user_stories.benefit: I can make an informed decision.

user_stories.capability: propose a settlement or record a decision

system_stories.responsibility: Prevent mediator access when a conflict of interest is declared.
Persist the mediator's proposed settlement or recorded decision.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Mediate Dispute
Goal: Allow a mediator to review order history and evidence, then propose a settlement or record a decision.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Mediator begins review of an open dispute.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: A dispute is open and evidence submission is complete or deadline has passed.
  - PRE-UC003-002: The mediator has no declared conflict of interest with the dispute.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Mediator reviews order history and evidence.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Mediator proposes a settlement or records a decision.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Mediator has conflict of interest
Source FRs: FR-005, FR-006

use_cases.name: Accept Settlement
use_cases.goal: Allow either party to accept a proposed settlement.
use_cases.trigger: A settlement is proposed by the mediator.

success_postconditions.text: The settlement is accepted by a party.

steps.action: Buyer or seller accepts the proposed settlement.

user_stories.benefit: I can resolve the dispute without further mediation.
I can resolve the dispute without further mediation.

system_stories.responsibility: Persist the acceptance of the proposed settlement.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Accept Settlement
Goal: Allow either party to accept a proposed settlement.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: A settlement is proposed by the mediator.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: A settlement has been proposed.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Buyer or seller accepts the proposed settlement.
Source FRs: FR-007

use_cases.name: Close Dispute
use_cases.goal: Close the dispute after a decision or mutual settlement.
use_cases.trigger: A decision is recorded or a settlement is accepted.

preconditions.text: A decision has been recorded or a settlement has been accepted.

steps.action: System closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.

system_stories.responsibility: Mark the dispute as closed and finalize its state.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-005 — Close Dispute
Goal: Close the dispute after a decision or mutual settlement.
Primary actor: ACT-004
Trigger: A decision is recorded or a settlement is accepted.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC005-001: A decision has been recorded or a settlement has been accepted.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC005-001] System closes the dispute after decision or mutual settlement.
Source FRs: FR-008
